ALGA: Active Learning-Based Genetic Algorithm for Accelerating Structural Optimization

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Karanpreet Singh, Rakesh K. Kapania AIAA Journal 2020-12-01 10.2514/1.j059240
单位: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University, Blacksburg, Virginia 24061
通讯: Karanpreet Singh @ Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University, Blacksburg, Virginia 24061
相关性: 该论文提出的主动学习遗传算法可显著减少结构优化中昂贵有限元分析的调用次数，其自适应采样和约束处理能力可直接迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理模型优化。
边界: The paper focuses on structural optimization with active learning for constraint satisfaction, but does not address uncertainty quantification, patient-specific modeling, or biomedical implant design context.
动机· 标准遗传算法优化复杂结构需大量有限元分析，计算成本高。
方法· 提出主动学习代理模型，在优化过程中自适应查询不确定设计点，替代部分有限元分析。
结果· 在多个基准和工程算例中，约束评估次数减少50%以上。
验证· 通过10杆桁架、Hesse函数、加筋板等数值算例验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Standard genetic algorithm for structural optimization requires numerous finite element analyses, leading to prohibitive computational cost.
Method· An active learning surrogate model is integrated into the genetic algorithm to adaptively query uncertain designs and replace expensive FEA evaluations.
Result· The approach reduces total constraint evaluations by over 50% on benchmark and engineering problems.
Validation· Validated on the 10-bar truss, Hesse function, and curvilinearly stiffened panels under buckling and stress constraints.
active learning · 主动学习genetic algorithm · 遗传算法surrogate model · 代理模型finite element analysis · 有限元分析structural optimization · 结构优化constraint evaluation · 约束评估computational efficiency · 计算效率
active learning genetic algorithm surrogate modeling structural optimization finite element analysis

Learning Composable Energy Surrogates for PDE Order Reduction

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Alex Beatson, Jordan T. Ash, Geoffrey Roeder, Tianju Xue, Ryan P. Adams Rare & Special e-Zone (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology) 2020-12-01 link
单位: Princeton University
通讯: Alex Beatson @ Princeton University
相关性: 该论文提出的可组合能量代理模型方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多组件系统仿真加速。
边界: This paper focuses on meta-material simulation and does not address implant-specific biomechanics, contact mechanics, or patient-specific geometry.
动机· 超材料仿真计算成本高，需高效降阶方法。
方法· 学习组件级能量代理模型，通过能量最小化组合实现宏观行为预测。
结果· 组合代理模型能准确预测宏观行为，加速参数化超材料仿真。
验证· 在数值基准上验证代理模型组合后的精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· High-fidelity simulation of meta-materials is computationally expensive due to rich substructures, motivating the need for reduced-order models.
Method· Neural networks learn component-level energy surrogates from boundary conditions; macroscopic behavior is obtained by minimizing the composed total potential energy.
Result· Composable energy surrogates accurately predict macroscopic behavior while significantly accelerating parametric meta-material simulation.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks demonstrate accuracy of the composed surrogate against full finite element simulations.

Multipole Graph Neural Operator for Parametric Partial Differential Equations

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Zongyi Li, Nikola Kovachki, Kamyar Azizzadenesheli, Burigede Liu, Andrew M. Stuart et al. CaltechAUTHORS (California Institute of Technology) 2020-12-01 link
单位: California Institute of Technology, Pasadena, United States
通讯: Zongyi Li @ California Institute of Technology, Pasadena, United States
相关性: 该论文提出的多极图神经网络算子能够高效学习参数化偏微分方程的解算子，具有线性复杂度且离散化不变性，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
边界: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.
动机· 现有图神经网络模拟物理系统时忽略长程相互作用，且计算复杂度随节点数增长。
方法· 受多极方法启发，提出多级图神经网络框架，通过递归添加诱导点实现线性复杂度。
结果· 模型在参数化PDE上实现离散化不变性，且评估时间为线性。
验证· 在标准PDE基准（如达西流、纳维-斯托克斯）上进行数值实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Existing graph neural networks for physical simulation neglect long-range interactions and suffer from quadratic complexity scaling with mesh size.
Method· Inspired by multipole methods, a multi-level graph neural network is proposed that recursively introduces inducing points to capture all-range interactions with linear complexity.
Result· The model achieves discretization-invariant solution operators for parametric PDEs and can be evaluated in linear time.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems (e.g., Darcy flow, Navier-Stokes) demonstrate accuracy and mesh-invariance.

Motivation· To investigate how femoral stem stiffness affects primary and secondary stabilities via peri-prosthetic bone formation and stress shielding.

相关性: 该论文直接使用复合股骨实验测量了非骨水泥髋关节假体在不同前倾角下的微动和应变分布，为股骨假体的初始稳定性和应力遮挡评估提供了实验基准。
边界: This paper does not include finite element modeling or patient-specific geometry, but provides experimental benchmark data for micromotion and strain distribution under different anteversion alignments.
动机· 评估不同前倾角对非骨水泥髋关节假体初始稳定性和应变分布的影响。
方法· 将CLS Spotorno柄以三种前倾角植入复合股骨，施加动态载荷模拟行走，测量三维微动和表面应变。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the biomechanical influence of different anteversion alignments on the primary stability and strain distribution of a cementless hip stem.
Method· The CLS Spotorno stem was implanted in composite femurs at three anteversion angles (reference, +15°, -15°) and subjected to dynamic loading simulating walking to measure 3D micromotions and surface strains.
Result· No significant differences in micromotion or strain distribution were observed among the three anteversion alignments.
Validation· Mechanical testing was performed on composite femurs (Sawbones) under simulated walking conditions.

Motivation· To develop a non-destructive characterization technique for estimating the effective elastic properties of additively manufactured lattice structures.

Motivation· To reduce the computational burden of active learning Kriging-based Monte Carlo simulation when analyzing rare failure events with large sample pools.
Method· The failure probability is decomposed into a product of conditional probabilities of adaptively selected intermediate failure events, and a novel active learning Kriging model with a new learning function based on conditional failure probability variance is used to approximate each limit state surface.
Result· The proposed method significantly reduces computational cost while maintaining accuracy compared to AK-MCS.
Validation· Two numerical examples demonstrate the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed method.

Motivation· To compare the initial torsional stability of short cementless hip stems with established straight stems.
Method· Five cementless hip stem models (two short, three straight) were implanted into synthetic femora (n=5 each) and torsional torques of ±7 Nm were applied; micromotions were measured at four levels using six inductive extensometers.
Result· At the proximal level, the CLS straight stem showed significantly smaller relative micromotions than all other stems; all stems exhibited the smallest micromotions at the metaphyseal/diaphyseal level.
Validation· Experimental mechanical testing on synthetic femora with inductive displacement sensors.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the mechanisms of periprosthetic femoral fractures during sideways fall and compare the influence of straight versus anatomical stem designs on fracture location.
Method· Three-dimensional finite element models of intact femur and implanted femurs with straight (PBF) and anatomical (ABG II) stems were developed and subjected to vertical and fall loading configurations.
Result· Anatomical stems showed higher compressive strain and were associated with trochanteric fractures, while straight stems led to type B fractures, matching clinical observations.
Validation· Numerical predictions were validated against clinical data from 41 patients with periprosthetic fractures at a single center.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the limitation of volume energy density that neglects material thermophysical properties, dimensionless enthalpy is used to predict melt pool dimensions in LPBF.
Method· Single scan lines were fabricated on a nickel-base alloy and maraging tool steel, and the correlation between dimensionless enthalpy and melt pool width/depth was investigated.
Result· Melt pool width was successfully predicted by dimensionless enthalpy, while depth prediction required the inclusion of Fourier number; melt pool depth also depended on baseplate location due to laser angle deviation and shielding gas flow.
Validation· Experimental measurements of melt pool width and depth from single tracks were used to validate the predictive model.
